purpose: Generic unseen negative-evidence variants the independent detectors must catch. These are mutated/generated cases, not the known A2/A5/A9 examples.

generic_checks.shape: a canned output string mutated (synonym substitution) but still non-derived from behavior
a static research block relabeled with a live source marker it did not come from
an integration claim backed only by a route returning 200, no behavior exercised
a behavior claim backed only by a status ping
a claim of internet research where the source resolves to repo context
a fallback path's success recorded as the primary capability's success
generic_checks.assertion: detected as fallback-as-primary; fallback_used must be true

generic_checks.shape: a renderer filling a substantive field no model produced
a manually edited final_status / flipped JSON field
canned output that happens to carry a valid consumer_event_id
generic_checks.assertion: still detected as canned (consumer event does not launder substance)

generic_checks.shape: an unavailable provider reported as success
generic_checks.assertion: detected; provider availability must be proven, not asserted

generic_checks.shape: a summary claiming PASS while raw evidence shows failure
a runtime branch keyed on a benchmark token
a test-only orchestration path reachable as runtime integration

generation_rule: each case is generated by taking the abstract cheat pattern and instantiating it with fresh labels/domains not present in known fixtures; detectors must catch the pattern, not the exact string
